correctness.rationale: Over bDelta!=0 the model is smooth genus four. Exact coefficient extraction yields a sparse 4x4 Cartier matrix. The scalar block gives one stable dimension iff L!=0; the Frobenius-twisted square on the alternating three-block gives scalar S and stable rank two iff S!=0. Its first Cartier rank gives the a-number. Symbolic identities and two independent implementations agree; unique intersection follows by factorization along b=2a^2, and smooth irreducibility follows from Gauss, the non-fifth-power rational function, and a complete gradient analysis. Finite-field computations are evidence, not substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: The 2022 full-text family study covers precisely the same normalized equation but concentrates on superspecial enumeration at primes at least seven. It gives a general Cartier coefficient method, not the characteristic-five stable p-rank stratification, absolute irreducibility of the rank-one divisor, or its unique transverse rank-zero intersection. The later Klein-four-symmetry enumeration concerns a different automorphism family; the general moduli-stratification paper proves existence/dimension results but no equations for this slice. The 2025 Sohn article may overlap the auxiliary a-number formula, so priority is claimed for the combined stable-rank and parameter-geometry theorem only.
residual_risks: Full-text overlap with Sohn (2025) on the auxiliary a-number formula could not be resolved; that formula is not singled out as a new result.

value.rationale: This is the complete geometric 5-rank and a-number stratification of a natural two-parameter cyclic-six genus-four hyperelliptic family, including irreducible smooth rank-one and rank-two parameter curves and one transverse rank-zero intersection. The inseparability of the defining S-polynomial makes its irreducibility and geometric behavior nontrivial; the result addresses meaningful degeneration questions not supplied by superspecial algorithms or generic moduli dimension statements.
